correctness.rationale: Two-step chip balance forces exactly one firing per vertex; the threshold interval proof yields the weighted cut partition function with no overcount. Its two-child recursion is exact and the matrix characteristic polynomial proves the integer product. Absolute convergence of the entropy series and an explicit tail computation yield the asymptotic constant. Actual standalone code reproduces heights 1–4, all cuts and 9350 graph transitions at h=3, and all bounded microstates at h=1,2. No inference from finite tests to all heights.

All heights admit an exact non-obvious product formula and a pure exponential per-vertex asymptotic with explicit positive prefactor; this measures the size of the recurrent two-cycle population across an infinite family and supplies a branching comparison with classical path Pell counts. No arbitrary finite slice or computational-only fact.
